thread:
lina: quick heads-up  HighlandCloud asked us to enable a glasgow-edge marketplace SKU (pilot) that bundles their SI + optional on-prem connector. they need quota, KMS routing plan, and customs/compliance checklist by next week.
callum: any SKU id from them? and are they asking for CI/CD hooks for the SI or just telemetry?
lina: placeholder SKU: HIGHLAND-GLA-EDGE-01. partner requests 6 A100-equivalent GPUs, 48 vCPU control-plane, 3TB egress/mo baseline. they want telemetry + billing hooks for the SI.
marco: ops: glasgow region needs a subnet carve and a partner-dedicated peering. also need to confirm whether HSM or KMS will be partner-managed. legal will need that to finalize the MOA.
tara: legal prefers BYOK for production. for pilot theyre okay with partner-managed keys if we get an appendix on custody, rotation, and breach notif. i'll draft redlines.
callum: network: will need ASN for peering and a list of IP ranges. also confirm port requirements (we typically need 443 + 9100 for SI telemetry).
marco: ops recommends we accept partner-managed KMS for a 30-day pilot but require proof of rotation logs and read-only telemetry token. that keeps launch fast.
infra-bot: ticket created: MKP-9987 - glasgow entitlement + KMS/HSM flow (assignee: marco). ETA: 2026-04-11.
lina: marketing wants to avoid a public announcement until pilot metrics are stable. partner wants co-branded listing but well do a private beta first.
tara: legal notes for the appendix: add section 5.2 (key rotation window 72h), 8.1 (breech notif 48h), and telemetry retention max 30d. also require CT logs for HSM if used.
callum: for quotas I'll file request for 6 GPUs, 48 vCPU, 3TB egress, subnet carve / peering. autoscaler min 2 max 12. need someone to confirm the GPU class mapping to our quant profiles.
marco: mapping confirmed: A100-eq -> profile: compute-heavy, fp16-quant enabled. i'll attach the quant table to the ticket.
lina: i'll intro Highland PM @ceo_highland and loop in partner ops. quick poll: reply with "+pilot-accept" to allow partner-managed keys for the pilot (30d) or "+req-byok" to insist BYOK even for pilot. need decision by EOD Thu.
marco: +pilot-accept (ops can capture rotation logs)
tara: +req-byok (legal prefers BYOK; can we require a managed fallback only if partner proves inability?)
callum: +pilot-accept (network overhead if they BYOK for pilot)
infra-bot: reminder: entitlement sync scheduled 2026-04-09 15:00 BST (calendar invite sent).
lina: thanks all. i'll kick off the intro and attach the ticket + MOA draft. ping if blockers.
